statement: Find all ordered pairs of positive integers $(x,y)$ with $x^3 + y^3 = x^2 + 42xy + y^2$.

Let $\triangle ABC$ be acute with $AB < AC$ and circumcircle $\omega$. Tangents at $B, C$ to $\omega$ meet at $L$. Line through $B$ parallel to $AC$ meets tangent at $C$ in $D$; line through $C$ parallel to $AB$ meets tangent at $B$ in $E$. Circumcircle of $\triangle BDC$ meets $AC$ at $T$; circumcircle of $\triangle BEC$ meets line $AB$ at $S$ (with $B$ between $S$ and $A$). Prove $ST$, $AL$, $BC$ are concurrent.
Find all $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ such that $n + f(m) \mid f(n) + nf(m)$ for all $m, n \in \mathbb{N}$.

$n > 2$ students sit at a circular table, each starting with one candy. Each step, simultaneously, each student either (A) gives one candy to a neighbor, or (B) splits all their candies into two sets and gives one set to each neighbor. A distribution is \textit{legitimate} if it can occur after finitely many steps. Find the number of legitimate distributions.
